mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals the start of an easing cycle, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected corporate cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, reducing equity risk appetite and compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in rate hike periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) over 3 months reduces consumer purchasing power, dampening corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising benefits periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below 2000 monthly triggers a risk-on reaction as expectations for job growth rise, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling benefits periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over 3 months signals weakening domestic demand, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in declining demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) over 3 months signals an inflationary environment, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in rising inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) below 275 over 3 months signals deflationary pressure, lowering discount rates and compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in deflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales (HOUST) over 3 months signals a strengthening economy, raising earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising sales periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
